fit.sheet: Mullard OC71 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC71 Issue 2, pages 158-1 to 158-20)
fit.figure: page 158-12 transfer characteristic at Vc = -4.5 V (IB 0 to 16 µA); page 158-13 Average transfer line (5 to 14 mA); page 158-7 IE against VBE at Vc = -4.5 V (both ranges); page 158-2 table (Ico, rbb', Cc, fα); page 158-3 h'22 (VAF)
fit.method: see NOTES.md (germanium study): transfer, VBE-IE and Ico fitted together at Vc = -4.5 V, leakage included. The transfer curve is kept as read under curves.transfer (IB, IC); points are its (IC, IC/IB), leakage included, so the lowest-current gains are high. Fitted points within 7.9 % (IC at IB) and 4.7 mV (VBE); ICBO 4.46 µA. Curves read off the raster by pixel (.claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/pix.py)
fit.note: Our own fit by pixel from Mullard's curves (D-184); germanium units vary widely, so give a measured hFE and leakage.
